reproduction.temporal_count_mismatch: EcoSimR rerun gave 4/32 aggregated versus 7/32 reported; no temporal segregation in either.

interpretation.spatial: Removing later within-night recaptures did not change a single grid-season spatial significance classification.
interpretation.temporal: Removing later recaptures did not reveal temporal segregation. Instead, RA3-standardized temporal aggregation became more frequent even though raw Czekanowski overlap generally decreased.
interpretation.caveat: FIRST-only is mechanically biased toward earlier checks and is a sensitivity representation, not a reconstruction of undisturbed activity.
